invariants: regular enemies should usually have one primary pressure verb and at most one secondary verb
enemy counters must not require one specific character
characters and pairs may gain alternate or stronger solutions without becoming mandatory
existing Current48 identities must not be replaced by legacy enemy names
legacy mechanics may be reused without reviving legacy identity or lore
enemy defeat should read as fixed meaning dissolving rather than biological gore
collection lore must remain optional for power progression
exact spawn damage cooldown and balance values remain open

pairModules.lowBondFailure: mark and collect false labels too quickly
pairModules.highBondSolution: delay target confirmation and temporarily hold ownerless targets
pairModules.playerLesson: use movement silhouette and context in addition to labels

pairModules.lowBondFailure: both defensive tools are spent on the same attack
pairModules.playerLesson: sequence protection instead of stacking it

pairModules.lowBondFailure: measured route is held too long or improvised route changes too often
pairModules.highBondSolution: alternate measured and adaptive route segments
pairModules.playerLesson: learn the conditions that change the safe line
maximum repair is not always the best repair

pairModules.lowBondFailure: Koyori is locked into safety while the small important signal is lost

pairModules.highBondSolution: separate observed difference from threat relevance
pairModules.playerLesson: not every difference is important, but uncertain warnings can still be useful

boss_name_without_owner.theme: name is not sufficient to establish ownership or personhood
boss_name_without_owner.counter: read silhouette movement behavior and context instead of UI label alone

boss_closed_morning_box.theme: safety can become imprisonment when choice and exit disappear
boss_closed_morning_box.counter: choose when to leave safety and attack during opening windows

boss_night_without_route.theme: a correct route can stop being correct
boss_night_without_route.counter: remember route history, read telegraphs and switch routes
